subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` remove persisted plugin install records whose primary path no longer exists when the plugin-registry check runs, including the `--only core/doctor/plugin-registry` path?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive persisted-state repair choice, and automation should not decide whether deletion is always preferable to reinstall-first behavior for existing upgraded users.

options.title: Accept Doctor-Owned Cleanup
options.body: Land the PR if maintainers agree missing-path install records are stale state that doctor may remove before rebuilding the registry.

options.title: Require Reinstall-First Semantics
options.body: Ask for the repair to avoid deleting records for configured plugins unless configured-plugin reinstall has already had a chance to run.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor-Owned Cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the PR if maintainers agree missing-path install records are stale state that doctor may remove before rebuilding the registry.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest history on the doctor registry repair path and installed-index refresh behavior touched by this compatibility choice.
